name: snytro-search-boost
description: Local document indexing and source-backed search for Codex and Claude Code, with a skill, CLI, CPU embeddings, and SQLite or PostgreSQL.

interface.shortDescription: Index and search selected local documents
interface.longDescription: Build persistent local document collections and answer questions with sources. Includes a CLI, SQLite or PostgreSQL storage, and optional CPU embeddings. The host agent supplies summaries and final answers. Model weights and user indexes are stored outside the plugin.
defaultPrompt: Set up Snytro and index these selected documents.
Search my Snytro collection and answer with sources.
